howto: Pick a stop on the World Tour and press START EVENT to surf its heat.
Hold W to pump down the face for speed and steer with A and D.
Tap Space near the lip to launch, then spin (A/D) and flip (W) in the air; hold Q to rotate faster.
Land straight to score the trick and grow your COMBO before the heat clock runs out.
tips: Link tricks quickly: the combo multiplier climbs to 8x and drops back when you stop.
A crooked landing is a wipeout: it costs 250 points and resets the combo.
Rocks and hazards in the water knock you off; carve around them.
Coins along the wave add to your score.
Bronze or better at a stop unlocks the next one on the tour.

controls.keyboard: A / D carve (arrows too), W pump, S brake, Space jump, Q or Shift trick boost, R restart the heat, M next map. On the tour: arrows and Enter.
controls.touch: On-screen buttons: < > carve, PUMP, JUMP and TRICK. Tap the tour cards and START EVENT.
controls.gamepad: Left stick carve, A jump, triggers pump and trick

difficulty: Seven tour stops in order, each with a higher target score and bigger surf; bronze unlocks the next stop.

cheats.effect: Every landing counts as clean and hazards can't knock you off
Half gravity: huge airs and easy multi-spins
The heat clock stops, so surf as long as you like

tricks.name: Launch
tricks.input: Space (JUMP) off the lip at speed

tricks.name: 360 Air
tricks.input: A or D in the air for one full spin

tricks.name: 720 Air
tricks.input: Keep spinning: A or D, hold Q to spin faster

tricks.name: Back Flip
tricks.input: Hold W in the air for a full flip

tricks.name: Double Flip
tricks.input: Hold W + Q in the air for two flips

tricks.name: Rodeo
tricks.input: A or D plus W together: spin and flip

settings.quality: GRAPHICS button on the World Tour screen: High (shadows, anti-aliasing) or Low

features.trick-system: Spins and flips counted in the air: 360 and 720 airs, back and double flips, rodeos, each scored on landing
features.trick-list: The arcade pause menu lists all seven tricks with their inputs
features.combo: COMBO multiplier up to 8x, built by linking tricks inside five seconds
features.land-bail-feedback: Clean landings pop the trick name and points with a splash and a landing sound; crooked landings wipe out with a tumble, -250 and a combo reset
features.trick-tutorial: A five-step guided first heat (pump, carve, launch, land a trick, combo) with Skip; Replay tutorial in the arcade menu runs it again
features.results: RUN COMPLETE card with score and best; the World Tour then banks the medal, XP and tour points
features.restart: Restart starts the heat again with a fresh countdown
features.reduced-motion: Follows the browser's reduced-motion setting: no camera shake, speed FOV kick or trick-name pop
